```{r setup}
library(targets)
tar_config_set(store = file.path("..", "_targets"))
if (requireNamespace("exdyn.sandbox", quietly = TRUE)) {
  library(exdyn.sandbox)
} else if (requireNamespace("pkgload", quietly = TRUE)) {
  pkgload::load_all(path = normalizePath(".."), export_all = FALSE, helpers = FALSE, attach_testthat = FALSE)
} else {
  stop("Package exdyn.sandbox not available.")
}
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(knitr)
library(tidyr)
library(readr)
library(purrr)
has_patchwork <- requireNamespace("patchwork", quietly = TRUE)
if (has_patchwork) {
  library(patchwork)
}

pilot_cfg <- tar_read(pilot_cfg)
pilot_scores <- tar_read(pilot_scores)
pilot_theta <- tar_read(pilot_theta)
pilot_grid <- tar_read(pilot_grid)
pilot_grid_info <- tar_read(pilot_grid_info)
pilot_vole_tx <- tar_read(pilot_vole_tx)
pilot_mink_field_default <- tar_read(pilot_mink_field_default)
pilot_output_dir <- tar_read(pilot_output_dir)
pilot_c_star_summary <- tar_read(pilot_c_star_summary)
pilot_guard_cfg <- tar_read(pilot_guard_cfg)
pilot_vole_tx_qc <- tar_read(pilot_vole_tx_qc)
pilot_guard_attempts <- pilot_guard_cfg$attempts
pilot_riparian_mask <- tar_read(pilot_riparian_mask)
pilot_riparian_table <- tar_read(pilot_riparian_table)
pilot_effort_years <- tar_read(pilot_effort_years)
pilot_effort_max_records <- tar_read(pilot_effort_max_records)
compat_cfg <- pilot_cfg$pilot$compat
mask_summary <- tar_read(pilot_mask_summary)
mask_results_tbl <- tar_read(pilot_mask_results_csv)
mask_matrices <- tar_read(pilot_mask_matrices)
tx_hyper_results <- tar_read(pilot_tx_sweep)$results
tx_hyper_summary <- tar_read(pilot_tx_hyper_summary)
resolution_sweep <- tar_read(pilot_resolution_sweep)
resolution_summary <- resolution_sweep$summary
resolution_details <- resolution_sweep$details
baseline_funnel <- tar_read(pilot_baseline_funnel)
segment_tx <- tar_read(pilot_segment_tx)
segment_cell_tx <- tar_read(pilot_segment_cell_tx)

compat_top <- pilot_scores %>% arrange(loss) %>% slice_head(n = 10)
pilot_bounds <- tibble::tibble(
  param = c("pred_c_min", "pred_c_max", "pred_scale_min", "pred_scale_max"),
  value = c(
    pilot_guard_cfg$cfg$pred_c[1],
    pilot_guard_cfg$cfg$pred_c[2],
    pilot_guard_cfg$cfg$pred_scale[1],
    pilot_guard_cfg$cfg$pred_scale[2]
  )
)
effort_taxa_tbl <- purrr::map_dfr(pilot_cfg$pilot$vole$normalize_taxa %||% list(), function(x) {
  tibble::tibble(
    name = x$name %||% x[[1]] %||% NA_character_,
    rank = x$rank %||% x[[2]] %||% NA_character_
  )
})
```

## Triage: mask, estimator, and resolution

```{r triage-metrics-setup}
arrival_tbl <- pilot_grid_info$lookup %>%
  dplyr::mutate(T_P = pilot_mink_field_default$T_P[cbind(.data$row_idx, .data$col_idx)])

metrics_from_df <- function(df) {
  n_units <- nrow(df)
  n_tx <- sum(!is.na(df$tx_obs))
  coverage <- if (n_units > 0) n_tx / n_units else NA_real_
  valid <- df %>% dplyr::filter(is.finite(.data$tx_obs), is.finite(.data$T_P))
  r2 <- if (nrow(valid) >= 3) {
    summary(stats::lm(tx_obs ~ T_P, data = valid))$r.squared
  } else {
    NA_real_
  }
  lag <- if (nrow(valid)) mean(valid$tx_obs - valid$T_P) else NA_real_
  tibble::tibble(
    n_units = n_units,
    n_tx = n_tx,
    coverage = coverage,
    r2_arrival = r2,
    lag_mean = lag
  )
}

baseline_tbl <- pilot_vole_tx$table %>%
  dplyr::left_join(arrival_tbl, by = "cell_id")
baseline_metrics <- metrics_from_df(baseline_tbl)

mask_metrics <- mask_results_tbl %>%
  dplyr::left_join(arrival_tbl, by = "cell_id")
mask_groups <- if (nrow(mask_metrics)) dplyr::group_split(mask_metrics, tau_km) else list()
mask_metrics <- if (length(mask_groups)) {
  purrr::map_dfr(mask_groups, function(df) {
    tau <- df$tau_km[1]
    metrics_from_df(df) %>%
      dplyr::mutate(tau_km = tau, .before = 1)
  }) %>%
    dplyr::arrange(tau_km)
} else {
  tibble::tibble(
    tau_km = numeric(),
    n_units = integer(),
    n_tx = integer(),
    coverage = numeric(),
    r2_arrival = numeric(),
    lag_mean = numeric()
  )
}

hyper_metrics <- tx_hyper_results %>%
  dplyr::left_join(arrival_tbl, by = "cell_id")
hyper_groups <- if (nrow(hyper_metrics)) {
  dplyr::group_split(hyper_metrics, baseline_window, hold_years, drop_fraction)
} else {
  list()
}
hyper_metrics <- if (length(hyper_groups)) {
  purrr::map_dfr(hyper_groups, function(df) {
    bw <- df$baseline_window[1]
    hold <- df$hold_years[1]
    drop <- df$drop_fraction[1]
    metrics_from_df(df) %>%
      dplyr::mutate(
        baseline_window = bw,
        hold_years = hold,
        drop_fraction = drop,
        .before = 1
      )
  })
} else {
  tibble::tibble(
    baseline_window = numeric(),
    hold_years = numeric(),
    drop_fraction = numeric(),
    n_units = integer(),
    n_tx = integer(),
    coverage = numeric(),
    r2_arrival = numeric(),
    lag_mean = numeric()
  )
}

resolution_metrics <- resolution_summary %>%
  dplyr::rename(n_tx = n_tx_obs) %>%
  dplyr::select(resolution_km, n_units, n_tx, coverage, r2_arrival, lag_mean)

comp_lookup <- tar_read(pilot_riparian_components)$table %>%
  dplyr::select(cell_id, comp_id, n_cells_comp)
segment_arrivals <- comp_lookup %>%
  dplyr::left_join(arrival_tbl, by = "cell_id") %>%
  dplyr::group_by(comp_id) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(
    T_P = mean(.data$T_P, na.rm = TRUE),
    n_cells_arrival = max(.data$n_cells_comp, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  )
segment_joined <- segment_tx %>%
  dplyr::left_join(segment_arrivals, by = "comp_id") %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    n_cells = dplyr::coalesce(.data$n_cells, .data$n_cells_arrival)
  )
segment_metrics <- metrics_from_df(segment_joined)

best_mask <- if (nrow(mask_metrics)) mask_metrics %>% dplyr::arrange(dplyr::desc(coverage)) %>% dplyr::slice_head(n = 1) else NULL
best_hyper <- if (nrow(hyper_metrics)) hyper_metrics %>% dplyr::arrange(dplyr::desc(coverage)) %>% dplyr::slice_head(n = 1) else NULL
best_resolution <- if (nrow(resolution_metrics)) resolution_metrics %>% dplyr::arrange(dplyr::desc(coverage)) %>% dplyr::slice_head(n = 1) else NULL

overview_rows <- list(
  tibble::tibble(scenario = sprintf("Baseline (τ = %.1f km)", pilot_cfg$pilot$vole$riparian_tau_km)) %>%
    dplyr::bind_cols(baseline_metrics)
)
if (!is.null(best_mask)) {
  overview_rows <- append(overview_rows, list(
    best_mask %>%
      dplyr::mutate(scenario = sprintf("Mask τ = %.1f km", tau_km)) %>%
      dplyr::select(scenario, n_units, n_tx, coverage, r2_arrival, lag_mean)
  ))
}
if (!is.null(best_hyper)) {
  overview_rows <- append(overview_rows, list(
    best_hyper %>%
      dplyr::mutate(scenario = sprintf("Hyper bw=%d, hold=%d, drop=%.1f", baseline_window, hold_years, drop_fraction)) %>%
      dplyr::select(scenario, n_units, n_tx, coverage, r2_arrival, lag_mean)
  ))
}
if (!is.null(best_resolution)) {
  overview_rows <- append(overview_rows, list(
    best_resolution %>%
      dplyr::mutate(scenario = sprintf("Resolution %d km", resolution_km)) %>%
      dplyr::select(scenario, n_units, n_tx, coverage, r2_arrival, lag_mean)
  ))
}
overview_rows <- append(overview_rows, list(
  tibble::tibble(scenario = "Segments (rook components)") %>%
    dplyr::bind_cols(segment_metrics)
))
triage_overview <- purrr::map_dfr(purrr::compact(overview_rows), dplyr::as_tibble)
```

```{r mask-maps, fig.width=7, fig.height=6}
mask_plots <- purrr::imap(mask_matrices, function(mat, tau) {
  tau_num <- as.numeric(tau)
  mask_df <- pilot_grid_info$lookup |>
    dplyr::mutate(mask = mat[cbind(.data$row_idx, .data$col_idx)]) |>
    dplyr::filter(.data$mask) |>
    dplyr::left_join(mask_results_tbl |> dplyr::filter(tau_km == tau_num) |> dplyr::select(cell_id, tx_obs), by = "cell_id") |>
    dplyr::mutate(has_tx = !is.na(.data$tx_obs))
  grid_plot <- pilot_grid |>
    dplyr::left_join(mask_df |> dplyr::select(cell_id, has_tx), by = "cell_id")
  ggplot(grid_plot) +
    geom_sf(aes(fill = has_tx), colour = NA) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = c("grey90", "#b2182b"), na.value = "grey95", name = "TX obs", labels = c("No", "Yes")) +
    coord_sf() +
    theme_minimal() +
    labs(title = sprintf("τ = %s km", tau), subtitle = sprintf("TX cells: %d", sum(mask_df$has_tx, na.rm = TRUE)))
})
if (has_patchwork) {
  patchwork::wrap_plots(mask_plots)
} else {
  mask_plots[[1]]
}
```

```{r hyper-map, fig.width=6.5, fig.height=6}
if (is.null(best_hyper) || !nrow(best_hyper)) {
  ggplot() +
    theme_void() +
    labs(title = "Hyper-parameter sweep: no combinations produced TX observations")
} else {
  best_h <- best_hyper %>% dplyr::slice(1)
  best_h_params <- list(
    baseline_window = best_h$baseline_window,
    hold_years = best_h$hold_years,
    drop_fraction = best_h$drop_fraction
  )
  best_h_cells <- tx_hyper_results %>%
    dplyr::filter(
      baseline_window == best_h_params$baseline_window,
      hold_years == best_h_params$hold_years,
      drop_fraction == best_h_params$drop_fraction
    ) %>%
    dplyr::select(cell_id, tx_obs)
  grid_hyper <- pilot_grid %>% dplyr::left_join(best_h_cells, by = "cell_id")
  ggplot(grid_hyper) +
    geom_sf(aes(fill = !is.na(tx_obs)), colour = NA) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = c("grey90", "#1b9e77"), name = "TX obs", labels = c("No", "Yes")) +
    coord_sf() +
    theme_minimal() +
    labs(
      title = sprintf("Best hyper sweep (bw=%d, hold=%d, drop=%.1f)", best_h_params$baseline_window, best_h_params$hold_years, best_h_params$drop_fraction)
    )
}
```

## Calibration diagnostics

```{r cstar-hist, fig.width=6, fig.height=4}
c_vals <- as.numeric(pilot_c_star_summary$values)
c_vals <- c_vals[is.finite(c_vals)]
if (length(c_vals)) {
  c_star_df <- tibble::tibble(c_star = c_vals)
  quant_tbl <- tibble::enframe(as.numeric(pilot_c_star_summary$quantiles), name = "label", value = "q")
  ggplot(c_star_df, aes(x = c_star)) +
    geom_histogram(bins = 30, fill = "#4575b4", colour = "white", alpha = 0.8) +
    geom_vline(
      data = quant_tbl,
      aes(xintercept = q),
      linetype = "dashed",
      colour = "#d73027"
    ) +
    labs(
      title = "Critical predation multiplier c* across mink-present cells",
      x = "c* (kill multiplier for zero growth)",
      y = "Cell count"
    ) +
    theme_minimal()
} else {
  ggplot() + theme_void() + labs(title = "No finite c* values computed.")
}
```

```{r guard-attempts}
guard_table <- tryCatch({
  purrr::map_dfr(pilot_guard_attempts, function(attempt) {
    attempt <- if (is.list(attempt)) attempt else list(mean_cov = attempt)
    tibble::tibble(
      attempt = attempt$attempt %||% NA_real_,
      mean_sim_extirpation = attempt$mean_cov %||% NA_real_,
      pred_scale_max = attempt$cfg$pred_scale[2] %||% NA_real_,
      pred_c_max = attempt$cfg$pred_c[2] %||% NA_real_
    )
  })
}, error = function(e) tibble::tibble())
if (nrow(guard_table)) {
  knitr::kable(guard_table, digits = 3, caption = "Guard draws before full screen")
} else {
  knitr::kable(
    tibble::tibble(message = "No guard draws were required (coverage already adequate)."),
    col.names = "Note"
  )
}

delta_cols <- grep("^delta_", names(pilot_scores), value = TRUE)
delta_defaults <- attr(pilot_mink_field_default, "delta_region")
if (length(delta_cols)) {
  delta_table <- pilot_scores %>%
    select(any_of(delta_cols)) %>%
    pivot_longer(everything(), names_to = "region", values_to = "delta_years") %>%
    mutate(region = gsub("^delta_", "", region)) %>%
    group_by(region) %>%
    summarise(mean_delta = mean(delta_years, na.rm = TRUE), sd_delta = sd(delta_years, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") %>%
    mutate(default = if (!is.null(delta_defaults) && region %in% names(delta_defaults)) delta_defaults[region] else NA_real_)
  knitr::kable(delta_table, digits = 2, caption = "Regional arrival lead (δ) in years")
}
```

## Methods (summary)

Water vole extirpations were inferred via a smoothed first-passage rule applied to GBIF presence-only counts after (i) restricting the analysis to riparian cells (`river_km ≥` `r pilot_cfg$pilot$vole$riparian_tau_km` km) and (ii) normalising by a curated list of mammal effort taxa (Mustelidae, Microtus, Arvicola amphibius, Ondatra zibethicus) between `r pilot_effort_years[1]`–`r pilot_effort_years[2]` (`≤` `r pilot_effort_max_records` records per taxon). Mink arrivals were converted to a predation field with a `r pilot_cfg$pilot$mink_P$ramp_years`-year logistic ramp, scaled by tunable amplitude (`scale`) and ramp shape (`gamma`), and shifted by regional arrival leads (`δ`) relative to GBIF detections. We adapted the predation prior using the critical kill rate `c*`, yielding bounds `[r round(pilot_guard_cfg$cfg$pred_c[1], 3), r round(pilot_guard_cfg$cfg$pred_c[2], 3)]`, and ran early guard draws that widen `pred_scale`/`c` if simulated coverage stays <0.01. The screen sampled `r nrow(pilot_theta)` parameter sets (α, dispersal scale, A/K, `c`, `h`, `scale`, `gamma`, δ-region, ramp years) at carrying capacity `K0 = ` `r pilot_cfg$pilot$screen$K0`. Compatibility scores combine r², mean lag (TX_obs − T_P), coverage, and anisotropy gap within riparian cells.

```{r param-bounds}
knitr::kable(pilot_bounds, caption = "Final predation parameter bounds used in the screen")
```

### Compatibility vs predation parameters

```{r partial-plots, fig.width=7, fig.height=4.5}
compat_long <- pilot_scores %>%
  select(pred_scale, gamma, pred_c, starts_with("delta_"), compatible) %>%
  tidyr::pivot_longer(-compatible, names_to = "parameter", values_to = "value") %>%
  mutate(is_compat = as.numeric(compatible))

ggplot(compat_long, aes(x = value, y = is_compat)) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.15, size = 0.6, colour = "#999999") +
  geom_smooth(method = "loess", formula = y ~ x, se = FALSE, colour = "#1b9e77", linewidth = 1) +
  facet_wrap(~parameter, scales = "free_x") +
  labs(
    y = "Compatibility rate (loess estimate)",
    x = "Parameter value",
    title = "Compatibility response to predation parameters"
  ) +
  scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0, 1)) +
  theme_minimal()
```

## Compatibility results

```{r compat-table}
compat_top %>%
  mutate(across(where(is.numeric), ~ round(., 3))) %>%
  knitr::kable(caption = "Top 10 parameter sets (lowest loss)")
```

```{r top-maps, fig.width=6.5, fig.height=6}
best_sim <- pilot_scores %>%
  arrange(loss) %>%
  filter(!is.na(tx_path)) %>%
  slice_head(n = 1)
if (!nrow(best_sim)) {
  ggplot2::ggplot() + ggplot2::theme_void() + ggplot2::labs(title = "No simulations produced finite TX outputs.")
} else {
  tx_file <- best_sim$tx_path[[1]]
  if (!file.exists(tx_file)) {
    tx_file <- file.path("..", tx_file)
  }
  tx_best <- readRDS(tx_file)
  sim_plot <- exdyn_plot_surface(
    tx_best,
    pilot_grid_info,
    sprintf("Simulated TX (rank %d)", best_sim$rank),
    "Year"
  )
  diff_plot <- exdyn_plot_surface(
    pilot_vole_tx$matrix - tx_best,
    pilot_grid_info,
    "Observed − simulated TX (years)",
    "Δ years"
  )
  if (has_patchwork) {
    sim_plot + diff_plot + patchwork::plot_layout(ncol = 2)
  } else {
    print(sim_plot)
    print(diff_plot)
  }
}
```

Best compatible set (first rank) satisfies thresholds:

```{r best-row}
best_row <- compat_top %>% filter(compatible) %>% slice_head(n = 1)
if (nrow(best_row)) {
  knitr::kable(best_row, caption = "Best compatible parameter set")
} else {
  knitr::kable(compat_top, caption = "No parameter set met all compatibility thresholds; showing top 10 by loss.")
}
```
